```sql
WITH lines AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           o.id  AS order_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM orders o
      JOIN order_lines ol      ON ol.order_id = o.id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
), agg AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(DISTINCT order_id)   AS order_count,
           sum(quantity)              AS quantity,
           sum(line_total_cents)      AS revenue_cents,
           count(DISTINCT variant_id) AS variant_count
      FROM lines
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       a.order_count,
       a.quantity,
       a.revenue_cents,
       a.variant_count
  FROM agg a
  JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id
 ORDER BY a.quantity DESC, a.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De aggregatie gebeurt nu op smalle rijen (alleen ids en getallen) in plaats van op rijen met de brede productkolommen, waardoor de sort van ~81k rijen niet meer naar schijf hoeft te spillen. De `products`-join gebeurt pas op de ~1750 geaggregeerde rijen. De `count(DISTINCT ...)`-semantiek en de kolomnamen en -volgorde blijven ongewijzigd.
